text:
maya-peopleops: Quick heads-up — new hire Amir (starts Mon 4/6) flagged two things: needs a wheelchair-accessible desk + ASL interpreter for day 1, and his background check hit an 'address mismatch' hold. Can we triage?
ashley-peopleops: Thanks for flagging — can you drop Amir's preferred arrival time and contact email? I can book the interpreter once we have the time. :white_check_mark:
maya-peopleops: Arrival 9am. Email is amir.khan@example.com. Prefer interpreter for the 9:00-11:00 chunk (orientation + I-9).
lina: Re: BG address mismatch — usually vendor asks candidate for a proof of address (utility bill or bank stmt). I can ping ClearHire and send Amir a secure upload link. Anyone already coordinated notary for I-9?
notary-bot: Available notary slots for next week:
```
Mon 08:00, Mon 08:30, Mon 12:00, Tue 08:30
```
Link: https://notary.example.com/book?org=redwood&candidate=amir
facility: We can reserve a wheelchair-accessible desk near the south entrance (closer to elevator). Will badge the south-entry door for escort pickup. Need full name for badge and whether Amir needs parking or curb drop-off.
matt-eng: I'll be Amir's host — can meet at 8:50 at south entrance and escort in. I can also do a quick laptop handoff if IT can pre-stage.
ashley-peopleops: I'll book ASL interpreter for 9:00-11:00. Does Amir prefer remote or in-person interpreter?
maya-peopleops: He requested in-person. Please book on-site.
lina: I emailed ClearHire asking them to re-run with the candidate-supplied utility bill. I also put a note to expedite once proof is uploaded. I'll send Amir the secure upload link in 5 mins.
hr-bot: Background vendor update: ClearHire — status: pending docs (address verification). Ticket #CH-7842.
notary-bot: Mon 08:30 slot reserved tentatively for Amir. Confirm to finalize booking: reply with `CONFIRM NOTARY 2951112223`
maya-peopleops: CONFIRM NOTARY 2951112223 — please finalize. Also please set reminder for Amir to bring passport OR state ID + social security card for I-9.
facility: Curb drop-off set to south entrance at 8:45. Reserved accessible desk (Desk A-3). Visitor parking spot 12 reserved; will hold with sign "Amir Khan".
ashley-peopleops: ASL interpreter booked (on-site) 9:00-11:00. Calendar invite sent to Amir and Matt.
lina: ClearHire replied — once Amir uploads a copy of a utility bill we should clear within 24 hrs. I sent the secure link and a short note.
matt-eng: Perfect. I'll pick up the badge from security and meet Amir at 8:50. IT — can you confirm laptop pre-stage? @ashley-peopleops can you ping IT?
ashley-peopleops: Pinging IT now.
human-it: (bot) Laptop for Amir queued for imaging; ETA ready by 8:30.
maya-peopleops: Thanks everyone — summary for the record: notary booked 8:30, interpreter on-site 9-11, accessible desk reserved, escort at 8:50, BG vendor waiting on utility bill upload (Lina following up). I'll close out once ClearHire confirms. :pray:
lina: I’ll update thread when ClearHire completes.
maya-peopleops: Last item — Amir asked about vegetarian lunch options. Any preferences we should note?
matt-eng: I’ll note vegetarian and gluten-free.
maya-peopleops: Great — done. Thanks team!
